name: Kiro Crew

form_factor.comment: Kiro Crew provides a local CLI, desktop app, responsive web dashboard, and mobile access through the dashboard and messaging integrations. Per-form-factor links: CLI: https://kiro.dev/docs/crew/; Desktop App: https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/releases; Web: https://kiro.dev/crew/; Mobile: https://kiro.dev/crew/.

released_in.comment: AWS and Kiro introduced Kiro Crew as an open-source persistent development workspace in August 2026.

latest_major_update.comment: Kiro Crew 0.6.0 shipped September 11, 2026 with selectable Kiro, Claude Code, and Codex harnesses, remote-crew chat, agent-managed monitor loops, cross-backend worker dispatch, longer turn and subagent limits, a Launchpad, richer session organization, and expanded sandbox and installer controls.

rules.comment: Kiro Crew uses the underlying Kiro CLI and carries project steering and agent configuration into persistent workspaces.

skills.comment: Crew Apps and persistent workspaces can combine agents, skills, schedules, integrations, and backend services.

hooks.comment: Kiro Crew inherits Kiro CLI hook support and adds scheduled and event-driven workspace automation.

mcp_servers.comment: The launch changelog documents MCP-backed integrations in Crew workspaces.

custom_commands.comment: The CLI exposes built-in chat, run, spawn, cron, service, and gateway commands; arbitrary user-defined command registration is inherited from Kiro rather than Crew-specific.

goal_command.comment: Checkpointed run tasks continue autonomously across multiple steps and sessions.

subagents.comment: The spawn command and dashboard support parallel agents and isolated workstreams.

monitor.comment: Heartbeats monitor systems until attention is needed, and the dashboard shows persistent task activity.

model_selection.comment: `kirocrew chat --model MODEL` selects the Kiro model for a session.

approval_mode.comment: Kiro Crew exposes workspace security and approval controls through Kiro CLI and its gateway.

sandbox_mode.comment: Local jail and container security modes are documented; `--no-jail` explicitly disables the default jail where supported.

resume.comment: Workspaces and checkpoints persist across sessions and restarts.

continue.comment: Kiro Crew is designed to continue development work beyond one session.

non_interactive.comment: `kirocrew chat --message MESSAGE` runs a one-message task, while `kirocrew run TASK.md` runs checkpointed autonomous work.

output_format.comment: CLI output is pipe-friendly, but no dedicated JSON or NDJSON output flag was found in the verified help.

statusline.comment: No user-configurable terminal statusline is documented.

telemetry.comment: Anonymous usage telemetry is documented with controls for disabling it.

custom_model_provider.comment: Current Kiro Crew runs on Kiro CLI and Kiro device-code authentication; arbitrary provider backends are not documented.

pricing.value: Open-source Apache-2.0 workspace; uses Kiro Free or paid Kiro plans
pricing.comment: Kiro Crew itself is open source and runs on the user's hardware; model usage follows the current Kiro plan.

some_free_usage.comment: Kiro offers a perpetual Free tier that can be used with the open-source Kiro Crew workspace.

no_account_required.comment: First launch guides Kiro device-code sign-in.

can_use_other_subscriptions.comment: Current setup uses Kiro authentication rather than other model-provider subscriptions.

hosted_agent.comment: Kiro Crew runs locally, on the user's remote hardware, or in the user's container. It is not a managed hosted agent service.

transcripts.comment: Persistent workspace history and checkpoints are core Crew features and are stored under the Crew data home.

transcript_location.value: Persistent workspace history under the Crew data home; exact path undocumented
transcript_location.comment: Persistent workspace history and checkpoints are core Crew features and are stored under the Crew data home.

keyboard_shortcuts.comment: The desktop app provides a system-wide hotkey; broader custom shortcut mapping is not documented.

theme_customization.comment: The desktop and dashboard interfaces include selectable themes.

auto_save.comment: Persistent workspace state and checkpoints are saved automatically.

debugging_output.comment: Global verbose output and doctor/service diagnostics are available.

context_window.comment: Crew preserves learned workspace context across sessions, while model context limits remain managed by Kiro CLI.

code_formatting.comment: No Crew-specific formatter control was found in the official sources reviewed.

git_integration.comment: Crew development workspaces operate on repositories and support parallel isolated workstreams and change review.

performance_mode.comment: No user-facing performance mode was found in the official sources reviewed.

ui_customization.comment: Desktop, responsive dashboard, Crew Apps, integrations, and configurable workspace surfaces are first-class.

notes: Kiro Crew is a distinct open-source persistent development workspace built on Kiro CLI. It adds unattended checkpointed runs, parallel spawning, schedules, heartbeats, desktop and responsive dashboard surfaces, and messaging integrations while executing on user-controlled hardware.
